title: Dense multi-clause boolean filters hurt readability
evidence: store.go:175 Players() packs six filter predicates into one && chain; server.go:175 similar in allFilteredMatches

title: strings.Title is deprecated in modern Go
evidence: server.go:153 uses strings.Title to derive tool titles; deprecated since Go 1.18 in favor of golang.org/x/text/cases
suggestion: Replace with an explicit title-casing helper; harmless here since inputs are ASCII tool names.

title: Silent zero on unparseable integer CSV fields
evidence: loader.go:60-69 atoi() returns 0 on any parse error, so a malformed goal/rating value is indistinguishable from a real 0
suggestion: Acceptable for demo data; consider logging dropped values. No observed impact — all datasets load cleanly (23954 matches, 18207 players).
